Your roof type

Find your roof, see how we fix it

01

Asphalt shingle

Get a quote →

The most common roof from Nanaimo to Campbell River. We repair worn patches or strip and replace the whole deck when shingles have aged out.

02

Cedar shake

Get a quote →

Cedar shake and shingle roofs need real know-how in a wet coastal climate. We repair split shakes or replace the roof when the wood has given up.

03

Metal

Get a quote →

Metal roofs are built for the long haul against Island weather. We repair fasteners and flashing, or replace the panels when the roof reaches the end.

04

Tile & slate

Get a quote →

Tile and slate reward careful hands. We replace cracked pieces and re-seat what's slipped, or take on a full replacement when it's time.

05

Flat & torch-on

Get a quote →

Flat and torch-on roofs are where oceanside water pools and finds its way in. We repair the membrane at the seams or replace it outright.

06

Inspections

Book an inspection →

A roof inspection tells you what you're actually dealing with before any quote. We check the roof and attic ventilation, then explain what we found in plain terms.

07

Moss & cleaning

Get a quote →

Moss holds moisture against your roof and shortens its life on shaded Island lots. We clear it and clean the surface so the roof can breathe and drain.

08

Gutters & fascia

Get a quote →

Gutters, soffit and fascia carry water off and away from the house. We repair, replace or clean them so the whole edge of your roof does its job.

Straight answers

What Island homeowners ask before they book

What does licensed and insured mean for me?

We carry a licence and insurance, so the work on your home is covered and done to code from the first fastener. It means the crew on your roof is accountable and the job meets the standard it should.

How long is the workmanship warranty?

Our work is backed by a 10-year workmanship warranty in writing. That's on top of the manufacturer's warranty on the materials themselves, so the roof and the install are both covered.

Which areas do you cover?

Our standard service area runs from Duncan up to Campbell River, taking in Nanaimo, Parksville and Qualicum Beach. Outside that stretch, tell us where you are and we'll check whether we can reach you.

What roof types do you work on?

Asphalt shingle, cedar shake and shingle, metal, tile, slate, and flat torch-on. We repair or fully replace any of them, so whatever's over your head, it's a roof we work on.

Do you offer financing?

Yes. You can spread the cost over 12 months at 0% interest, so a leak or an aged-out roof gets handled now instead of waiting for the money to line up.
